[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Policy as Code in Terraform with Open Policy Agent (OPA) and Conftest"},{"order":2,"type":"subheading","text":"Introduction to Policy as Code"},{"order":3,"type":"paragraph","text":"Policy as Code (PaC) allows platform engineering teams to enforce security, compliance, and operational best practices across infrastructure provisioning. By defining rules in code, organizations can automate governance checks during the CI/CD pipeline before any Terraform resources are applied."},{"order":4,"type":"subheading","text":"Prerequisites and Tooling"},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Terraform installed locally to generate execution plans."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Conftest CLI installed to write and evaluate policies against structured data."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Basic understanding of Rego, the query language used by Open Policy Agent (OPA)."},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 1: Generate the Terraform Execution Plan"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"To evaluate policies against your infrastructure configuration, Conftest requires a JSON representation of the Terraform plan. Run the following commands to initialize, plan, and export the plan as JSON."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"terraform init
terraform plan -out=tfplan.binary
terraform show -json tfplan.binary > tfplan.json"},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 2: Write the Conftest Policy"},{"order":12,"type":"paragraph","text":"Create a directory named policy and add a Rego file named deny_public_s3.rego. This policy checks if any AWS S3 bucket resource allows public access, which violates internal security compliance."},{"order":13,"type":"code","text":"package main

deny["S3 buckets must not be publicly accessible"] {
    resource := input.resource_changes[_]
    resource.type == "aws_s3_bucket"
    resource.change.after.acl == "public-read"
}"},{"order":14,"type":"subheading","text":"Step 3: Execute Conftest Validation"},{"order":15,"type":"paragraph","text":"With the policy and the JSON execution plan ready, you can now run Conftest to validate your Terraform configuration. Conftest will parse the JSON plan against the Rego policies and report any violations."},{"order":16,"type":"code","text":"conftest test tfplan.json --policy policy/"},{"order":17,"type":"subheading","text":"Conclusion and Best Practices"},{"order":18,"type":"paragraph","text":"Integrating Conftest and OPA into your CI/CD pipeline ensures that security guardrails are automatically enforced. Always run policy validations prior to the terraform apply stage to catch configuration drift and compliance failures early."}]
